default_gui_native_drag.reason: Current CCB/rmux/tmux policy enables mouse on, so ordinary pane drag enters application mouse reporting rather than WezTerm's default GUI selection path.

negative_binding_assertion.reason: Absence of MouseDrag1Pane or copy-mode -M bindings is necessary regression protection but does not prove the foreground terminal can select text.

shift_bypass.reason: Shift bypass is a possible explicit user gesture, but it has not been selected, documented, or foreground-validated as the supported default route.

tmux_rmux_copy_mode_selection.reason: Copy-mode selection would change the interaction contract from WezTerm GUI-native selection to tmux/rmux-like selection.

unsupported_capability.reason: No approved default native drag route exists under current mouse on policy; runtime behavior remains unchanged.

explicitly_rejected_routes.name: claim_no_copy_mode_binding_as_native_pass
explicitly_rejected_routes.reason: This only proves a command was not bound; it does not observe WezTerm GUI selection.

explicitly_rejected_routes.name: silent_shift_bypass_as_default
explicitly_rejected_routes.reason: A modifier bypass changes the user action and must be explicitly accepted and validated.

explicitly_rejected_routes.name: copy_mode_selection_as_gui_native
explicitly_rejected_routes.reason: Copy-mode may be a valid separate feature strategy, but not a GUI-native parity pass.
